question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Performance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given passage,** it is mentioned that in large quantities, glutamate alters the (blank number 5) of a brain region involved in planning and decision making, specifically the lateral prefrontal cortex (lPFC).
 
• The word **"performance" **best fits the context as it refers to the functioning, capability, or efficiency of a brain region.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Normally used to send signals from nerve cells, in large quantities glutamate alters the performance of a brain region involved in planning and decision making, the lateral prefrontal cortex (lPFC).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) "synergy"** refers to the interaction or cooperation of multiple elements to produce a combined effect. While synergy can be important in brain function, it is not directly related to the alteration of a brain region.
 
• **Option 3) "radiation" **is unrelated to the functioning or alteration of a brain region in this context. "Radiation" typically refers to the emission or transmission of energy in the form of electromagnetic waves or particles.
 
• **Option 4) "ensemble" **refers to a group of individuals or elements working together as a whole. While the brain consists of various interconnected regions, "ensemble" does not accurately describe the alteration of a specific brain region.
